import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Initialize submission folder
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_df = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

class_names = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
class_map = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(class_names)}
label_list = list(class_map.values())

# Prepare training labels
y = train_df["author"].map(class_map).values

# Proper train/val split (hold-out validation - DO NOT use this for training)
X_train_text, X_val_text, X_train_label_idx, X_val_label_idx = train_test_split(
    train_df["text"], y.astype(int), test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Build pipeline with enhanced TF-IDF (unigrams + bigrams + trigrams) + char_wb
pipe = Pipeline(
    [
        (
            "tfidf",
            TfidfVectorizer(max_features=100000, ngram_range=(1, 3), char_wb=True),
        ),
        ("clf", LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000, C=0.1, n_jobs=-1)),
    ]
)

# Train on training data ONLY (never touch validation set)
pipe.fit(X_train_text.values, X_train_label_idx)

# Compute official log loss on validation set following formula:
# -1/N sum(sum(y_ij * log(p_ij)))
validation_log_loss_vals = []
for i in range(len(X_val_text)):
    prob_row = pipe.predict_proba(X_val_text.values)[i]
    true_label = X_val_label_idx[i]
    one_hot_true = np.zeros(3)
    one_hot_true[true_label] = 1

    # Avoid log(0) and clip extreme values
    prob_safe = prob_row + 1e-15
    prob_safe = np.clip(prob_safe, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

    loss_i = -one_hot_true @ np.log(prob_safe)
    validation_log_loss_vals.append(loss_i)

average_log_loss = np.mean(np.array(validation_log_loss_vals))
print(f"{average_log_loss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on TEST set (this set is truly unseen during training/validation)
y_test_probas = pipe.predict_proba(test_df["text"])

# Format output matching sample_submission template
predictions_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": y_test_probas[:, 0],
        "HPL": y_test_probas[:, 1],
        "MWS": y_test_probas[:, 2],
    }
)

# Save to submission file at correct path
predictions_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
